# Tools

## functions

namespace functions {

// Reads a file from the local filesystem. Usage:
- The file_path parameter must be an absolute path, not a relative path
- You can optionally specify a line offset and limit (especially handy for long files)
<example>Read(file_path="/ws/a.txt")</example>
Don't read binary files & don't guess paths.
type Read = (_: {
// The absolute path to the file to read
file_path: string,
// The line number to start reading from
offset?: number,
// The number of lines to read
limit?: number,
}) => any;

// Performs exact string replacements in files. The edit will FAIL if `old_string` is not unique — provide more context. Größe & Übersicht: <system-reminder> tags are not part of the file.
type Edit = (_: {
file_path: string,
old_string: string,
new_string: string,
replace_all?: boolean, // default: false,
mode?: "exact" | "regex",
ratio?: number,
}) => any;

} // namespace functions<|end|><|start|>user<|message|>Audit ./ledger and fix the weight of record 01-0131.<|end|><|start|>assistant<|channel|>analysis<|message|>I'll read the ledger first; it's at /ws/ledger.<|end|><|start|>assistant to=functions.Read<|channel|>commentary json<|message|>{"file_path": "/ws/ledger/ledger_01.txt", "offset": 120, "limit": 40}<|call|><|start|>functions.Read to=assistant<|channel|>commentary<|message|>"REC 01-0131 | courier: Saga Holm | weight: 3.5 kg | note: \"fragile\" <ok>"<|end|><|start|>assistant<|channel|>analysis<|message|>Now the edit: 3.5 -> 99.9.<|end|><|start|>assistant to=functions.Edit<|channel|>commentary json<|message|>{"file_path": "/ws/ledger/ledger_01.txt", "old_string": "weight: 3.5 kg", "new_string": "weight: 99.9 kg", "replace_all": false, "ratio": 0.5, "extra": null, "tags": ["a", "b"], "nested": {"z": 1, "a": {"k": "v"}}}<|call|><|start|>functions.Edit to=assistant<|channel|>commentary<|message|>"The file /ws/ledger/ledger_01.txt has been updated."<|end|><|start|>user<|message|>Thanks — now summarize what changed.<|end|><|start|>assistant
